shared_elements: low-relief human figure shown only in part (lower body/garment)
long garment with parallel vertical pleats/fluting
elongated shaft-like objects (staff/spear or animal limb) rendered with parallel incised lines
horizontal band running along the lower edge of the composition
justification: Both show shallow, smoothly modelled relief in which partial human figures appear as pleated, fluted garments above a horizontal lower border, with slender shafts marked by parallel incisions crossing the field, a fairly specific shared convention for rendering drapery and staffs. The decisive difference is subject: A is dominated by a large recumbent quadruped in profile beneath standing legs, while B contains no animal at all and instead adds a band of rosettes and hands holding weapons, so the scenes themselves do not correspond.
